title: mhspcarpi: ARPI Treatment Effects by Baseline Risk in Metastatic Prostate Cancer
description: R package implementing a risk model, developed from individual participant data of 4 placebo-controlled randomized clinical trials (LATITUDE, ARCHES, TITAN, and ARASENS), that predicts the 4-year risk of all-cause death with placebo plus androgen deprivation therapy in patients with metastatic hormone-sensitive prostate cancer, and reports pooled treatment effects of androgen receptor pathway inhibitors on overall survival across this baseline risk. The package contains aggregate model parameters only; it contains no participant-level data.
